# Overlay on machine_pinned.txt: a foreign profile (unitree_go2_1) grabbed enp36s0f1
# and the manipulation arm does not answer anywhere. repair() re-activates the arm
# profile on f1 (only non-frozen NIC), the probe fails, the NIC is released, and the
# profile is put back where it was so NM autoconnect keeps working.

lo:loopback:unmanaged:
